newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia, IMF see 1997 growth if policies right.
newsitem.headline: Russia, IMF see 1997 growth if policies right.

text.p: The Russian economy could return to growth this year, provided the authorities implement policy plans in full, IMF head Michel Camdessus and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said in a joint statement on Thursday.
The statement, released before Camdessus' news conference, said both sides agreed that Russia needed to boost tax revenues, approve a new tax code and deepen structural reforms.
